findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Quản lý gọn hơn. Thu phí rõ ràng. Đối soát dễ dà" → 3 lines (12 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: Hero headline is 12 words ("Quản lý gọn hơn. Thu phí rõ ràng. Đối soát dễ dàng."). Gallery median is 5.
findings.fix: Say the one thing. Move the rest to the supporting line.

findings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Đồng bộ 2 chiều tức thì" (pill) above "Một tài khoản duy nhất — Vận hành toàn b"; "Thời gian tiết kiệm" above "~27 giờ"; "Thất thoát thu hồi" above "~2.700.000 ₫"; "Tỷ lệ sai lệch nợ" above "0%"; "Gói Chuyên nghiệp" above "199.000 đ"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): section#da-thiet-bi.py-16.lg:py-24 → linear-gradient(rgb(245, 247, 251), rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(245, 247, 251))
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 22 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: button.px-6.py-3.5 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(37, 56, | div.bg-white.dark:bg-slate-900 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0 | button.px-3.5.py-1.5 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(37, 56,
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with gradient fill.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 21 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.bg-[#0B0F19].dark:bg-[#060911] 1440px | header.border-b.border-[#E4E7EC] 1440px | div.grid.grid-cols-3 479px | div.flex.items-center 689px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 24 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 4 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 3, 3, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "100%" 3.5:1 needs 4.5:1; "Dự kiến thu" 3.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "Đã thu 88%" 3.6:1 needs 4.5:1; "10 người (Quy mô nhỏ)" 3.6:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.

findings.message: Typeface(s) declared but not loaded, so a fallback is rendering: __Be_Vietnam_Pro_0df554
findings.fix: Fix the font URL / family name, or the screenshots you are judging are not the design.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 12px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 138 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 114 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 48px (3.3vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section.py-12.bg-white at 4331px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 7 screens in a row: "Sử dụng mượt mà trên Desktop, Tablet, Kiosk và Mobile"
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: Only 6 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "Quản lý gọn hơn. Thu phí rõ ràng. Đối soát dễ dà" → 3 lines (12 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 16px at 768px. Widest offenders: div.absolute.-bottom-10 (+16px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Quản lý gọn hơn. Thu phí rõ ràng. Đối soát dễ dà" → 3 lines (12 words, 30px); "Sử dụng mượt mà trên Desktop, Tablet, Kiosk và M" → 3 lines (10 words, 24px); "Quản lý chuyên cần và học phí không bao giờ sai " → 3 lines (12 words, 24px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 16px from the left edge but only to 41px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).
